label: DiskStation DS1522+ 5-bay NAS
description: 5-bay desktop NAS with four 1GbE RJ45 ports and a PCIe 3.0 x2 network upgrade slot for a 10GbE module. No out-of-band management port.
notes: Onboard: 4x 1GbE RJ45 (same count as the DS1520+ it replaced - the DS923+ by contrast has only two). PCIe 3.0 x2 network upgrade slot takes the E10G22-T1-Mini 10GbE copper module. No OOB management port.
